overview: The paper proposes MAVEN, a mesh-aware volumetric encoding network that explicitly models high-dimensional geometric elements (3D cells and 2D facets) alongside vertices to simulate 3D flexible deformations and contacts, particularly under sparse mesh discretization, achieving state-of-the-art performance on elastic and elastoplastic deformation datasets.

modules.name: Data Loading & Preprocessing Module
modules.description: Handles the loading of simulation trajectory data, normalizes physical quantities (displacement, velocity, stress, strain) and geometric features, and manages dataset splitting for training, validation, and testing.

modules.name: Mesh Geometry & Graph Topology Module
modules.description: Constructs and manages the sets of vertices, facets, and cells from raw mesh data, builds their adjacency relationships, and computes initial geometric features such as volume, surface area, and perimeter for cells and facets.

modules.name: Contact Detection Module
modules.description: Implements a Bounding Volume Hierarchy (BVH) algorithm to efficiently detect interacting facet pairs within a specified collision radius, and computes translation-equivariant geometric features (relative displacements, normal vectors) for face-to-face edges.

modules.name: Feature Encoder Module
modules.description: Encodes input features for all node types and edges, including physical quantities for vertices, current and initial geometric features for cells and facets, facet-to-facet contact features, and scripted external force features for constrained boundary conditions.

modules.name: Geometric Aggregator Module
modules.description: Implements position-aware learnable aggregation mechanisms based on local coordinate systems to map and aggregate vertex features into higher-dimensional cell and facet nodes, using MLPs to compute normalized aggregation weights that mimic finite element shape functions.

modules.name: Cell-Facet Message Passing Module
modules.description: Implements the two-stage message passing process over the bipartite cell-facet graph: first updating facet nodes by aggregating contact information and adjacent cell features, then updating cell nodes by aggregating features from their boundary facets.

modules.name: Geometric Disaggregator Module
modules.description: Distributes updated cell-level features back to their associated vertex nodes using symmetric aggregation coefficients, and applies residual connections along with feed-forward networks to produce smooth intermediate vertex feature updates.

modules.name: MAVEN Model Architecture Module
modules.description: Integrates the encoder, geometric aggregator, multi-layer processor (containing cell-facet message passing and disaggregator), and decoder into the complete Encoder-Processor-Decoder pipeline, managing the forward propagation flow and latent state transitions.

modules.name: Decoder & State Updater Module
modules.description: Maps the final processed vertex latent features to the target physical domain using MLPs to predict next-step velocity and physical quantities, and performs numerical integration to estimate the updated vertex positions.

modules.name: Loss Function Module
modules.description: Computes the one-step Mean Squared Error (MSE) loss between predicted and ground-truth values for both mesh positions and additional physical quantities like inner stress and equivalent plastic strain.

modules.name: Training & Optimization Workflow Module
modules.description: Manages the overall training loop, handles mini-batch processing, implements the Adam optimizer with learning rate scheduling, and executes gradient backpropagation and parameter updates.

modules.name: Autoregressive Rollout Module
modules.description: Implements the iterative inference logic where the model's one-step predictions are fed back as input historical states to unroll and generate full-length physical simulation trajectories.

modules.name: Evaluation & Metrics Module
modules.description: Calculates Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) averaged over rollout steps and trajectories for positions and physical quantities, providing standardized metrics to assess long-term simulation accuracy.

modules.name: Baseline Models Integration Module
modules.description: Implements and adapts baseline graph neural network architectures (MGN, Graph Transformer, HCMT, HOOD, FIGNet) to ensure standardized comparison under equivalent parameter budgets and computational constraints.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework Module
modules.description: Provides experimental configurations to systematically evaluate core components by replacing the geometric aggregator with simple averaging, zero-padding geometric features, or removing explicit cell/facet node modeling to validate their individual contributions.

modules.name: Visualization & Error Mapping Module
modules.description: Generates 3D visualizations of simulated meshes across timesteps and overlays spatial error maps on the geometry to qualitatively assess deformation fidelity and contact representation accuracy compared to ground truth.
